text: Remember that laws in economics often describe general trends or relationships between variables. Consider how price changes affect consumer behavior and their willingness to purchase at different prices according to the Law of Demand. Think about whether higher costs lead consumers to buy more or less within a given time frame when all other factors remain unchanged.

The Law of Demand suggests there's an inverse relationship between price and quantity demanded; as one goes up, typically so does the other in this context. Consider what happens to your purchasing behavior when prices go up for a product you regularly buy.
